Job Summary
The BFL Data Technologies team requires a hands-on Lead Data Architect / Data Engineering leader to design, modernize, and govern scalable enterprise data platforms across PostgreSQL, Azure, Databricks, Delta Lake, and cloud-native data services. The role will lead a team of data engineers and database specialists, own solution architecture and delivery quality and automation practices, and ensure reliable, secure, cost-optimized, and data products for business and analytics stakeholders.
Duties and Responsibilities
  • Data Architecture, Strategy and Delivery Leadership: Lead the design and delivery of enterprise-grade data solutions across PostgreSQL, Azure Data Services, Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Data Lakehouse, and related cloud data platforms.
  • Translate business, product, analytics, regulatory, and operational requirements into scalable data architecture patterns, technical roadmaps, and delivery plans.
  • Define standards for data modelling, database design, lakehouse layering, data contracts, coding practices, reusable frameworks, and solution documentation.
  • Own architecture reviews, design governance, technical risk assessment, delivery health, and stakeholder communication for critical data initiatives.
  • Hands-on Data Engineering and Database Development: Design, build, review, and optimize batch, micro-batch, and near-real-time ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Spark, SQL, Python, and orchestration tools.
  • Provide deep PostgreSQL expertise covering schema design, indexing, query optimization, stored procedures, partitioning, execution plan analysis, replication patterns, and performance tuning.
  • Implement Lakehouse design patterns such as bronze, silver, and gold layers, Delta tables, schema evolution, incremental processing, change data capture, and reusable curated data products.
  • Drive engineering excellence through peer reviews, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, environment promotion, release controls, and version management using Azure DevOps or GitHub.
  • People Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data engineers, database developers, and platform specialists through technical coaching, design walkthroughs, code reviews, and capability-building plans.
  • Partner with business, product, analytics, risk, security, infrastructure, and application teams to align data solutions with enterprise priorities and measurable business outcomes.
  • Communicate architecture decisions, delivery progress, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
  • Promote a culture of ownership, documentation, automation, quality, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data for analytics, AI, and operational use cases.
Required Qualifications and Experience
Qualifications: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline. Relevant certifications in Azure, Databricks, PostgreSQL, data architecture, cloud data engineering, or data governance will be an added advantage.
Work Experience: 6 to 9 years of progressive experience in database engineering, data architecture, cloud data platforms, or enterprise data engineering, including hands-on delivery experience and at least 3 years of leading, mentoring, or technically governing engineering teams in BFSI, fintech, or large-scale technology environments.

  • Strong hands-on expertise in PostgreSQL, including database design, SQL development, indexing, query tuning, partitioning, performance troubleshooting, and high-volume transactional or analytical workloads.
  • Deep working knowledge of Azure data ecosystem, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Storage, Azure SQL, Azure Synapse or Fabric concepts, Key Vault, and cloud-native security patterns.
  • Strong experience with Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, medallion architecture, job orchestration, workload tuning, and scalable lakehouse implementation.
  • Ability to design and govern enterprise data models, canonical data definitions, data contracts, metadata standards, reusable patterns, and domain-oriented data products.
  • Experience with ETL/ELT design, CDC, batch and streaming integration, API-based ingestion, orchestration, dependency management, and pipeline recovery patterns.
  • Exposure to NoSQL and distributed data stores such as Cosmos DB, MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, or similar technologies for appropriate use cases.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Sophos is seeking an experienced and motivated Incident Response Consultant to join our Incident Response (IR) service. The Sophos IR team is an elite group of incident responders that are engaged by organizations worldwide to respond to and neutralize cyber threats. Specializing in industry-standard forensic tools and Sophos technologies, the team provides comprehensive investigations, response actions, remediation guidance, and root cause analysis to combat a wide range of cybersecurity incidents.

As a Senior Incident Response Consultant on the Sophos IR team, you will be responsible for spearheading incident response engagements for customers who have experienced a cybersecurity attack. In this role, you will lead a team of Incident Response Consultants, running customer-facing calls, providing detailed written updates via email, and determining the priorities of the investigation, delegating tasks accordingly to your team.

In this role, you will be accountable for ensuring that the appropriate actions have been taken by both your team and the customer to effectively neutralize the threat. Additionally, you will be tasked with conducting a thorough root cause analysis to determine the origin of the incident, including identifying whether any data exfiltration occurred, provided the necessary evidence is available.

At the culmination of each engagement, you will be responsible for producing an executive summary-style report, which will include a timeline of key events mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK framework. This comprehensive report will serve as a valuable resource for stakeholders, highlighting the steps taken to combat the cybersecurity incident and provide remediation guidance.

The ideal candidate for this role will possess extensive experience leading incident response efforts, a deep understanding of cybersecurity threats and mitigation strategies, and the ability to communicate complex technical information to executive-level stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

What you will do

  • Lead kick off calls with customers to understand their situation and identify initial response actions to contain the threat
  • Provide guidance to customers on best practices following an incident
  • Lead daily update calls for customers to deliver forensic findings
  • Deliver concise email updates to customers between update calls
  • Direct the forensic investigations, identify priorities, and delegate tasks to analysts
  • Conduct multiple Rapid Response incidents concurrently
  • Determine TTPs identified by analysts and add them to the threat intel platform
  • Write clear and concise Executive Summary style reports in a timely manner
  • Responsible for basic to moderate complexity projects that contribute to the development of the Sophos Rapid Response service
  • Provide daily handover notes to teams located in different time zones, or when incident responsibility is being transferred to another Incident Lead

What you will bring

  • 5+ years of experience leading incident response investigations involving ransomware
  • Experience leading BEC investigations
  • Continuously learning and staying informed of the changing threat landscape
  • Proven track record of successful neutralization and remediation of ransomware threats
  • Excellent understanding of the Incident Response process
  • Excellent understanding of cyber risks and able to qualify them to customers
  • Excellent oral communication skills
  • Strong written communication skills
  • Ability to manage time effectively
  • Able to delegate and prioritize tasks across multiple incidents
  • Able to excel under stressful circumstances
  • Occasionally willing to begin work early and/or stay late when warranted for customer engagements
  • Strong grasp of the MITRE ATT&CK framework
  • Enjoy mentoring and assisting in the development of junior analysts
  • A team-player attitude with a willingness to share knowledge
  • Ability to work on weekends and holidays
  • Post-secondary education in Cybersecurity, comparable
  • Desirable: Cybersecurity certifications an asset (e.g. CISSP, GCFA, or similar)
  • Experience with SIEM technology (e.g. Splunk, ELK, etc.)
  • Willingness to work occasional overtime during peak times or holidays
  • Experience writing SQL queries
  • Experience writing PowerShell, Python, or Bash scripts

About us


Graphcore is one of the worlds leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute.

Graphcores teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.


Job Summary


Reporting to senior leadership within Architecture and Validation, the Power and Performance Validation Lead will drive validation strategy and execution for advanced AI compute silicon and systems. The role is responsible for leading power, thermal and performance validation activities across pre-silicon and post-silicon environments to ensure products meet efficiency, reliability and scalability expectations.


This role combines deep technical expertise with people leadership responsibilities, including team development, prioritisation, mentoring and delivery coordination across multiple projects and stakeholders.


The Team


The Power and Performance Validation team sits within the Architecture and Validation organisation and is responsible for validating the performance, efficiency and thermal behaviour of Graphcore silicon and systems.


The team supports the full product lifecycle, from early architectural modelling through to first silicon bring-up, characterization and production readiness. Engineers work closely with cross-functional teams globally to debug complex issues, optimize workloads and continuously improve validation infrastructure and methodologies.


Responsibilities and Duties



  • Define and lead validation strategies for power, thermal and performance characterization of AI compute silicon and platforms

  • Lead, mentor and support a team of validation engineers, providing technical guidance, coaching and career development

  • Drive planning, prioritisation and execution of validation activities across multiple projects and milestones

  • Develop comprehensive validation plans covering functional, stress, workload and corner-case scenarios

  • Lead post-silicon bring-up and characterization activities for power and performance validation

  • Drive validation of CPU, memory, interconnect and high-speed I/O subsystems under complex workload conditions

  • Develop scalable automation frameworks, regression infrastructure and reporting tools using Python

  • Design and execute benchmark workloads, parameter sweeps and performance experiments to identify optimization opportunities

  • Collaborate with architecture, RTL, firmware, software and systems teams to debug and resolve complex technical issues

  • Define validation metrics, pass/fail criteria and reporting methodologies to ensure repeatable and high-quality analysis

  • Guide development of custom workload generators and micro-benchmarks where required

  • Analyse power, thermal and performance data to identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of validation processes, tooling and engineering practices

  • Communicate technical findings, project status, risks and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and engineering leadership

  • Support hiring activities, onboarding and team growth initiatives


Candidate Profile


Essential:



  • Strong experience in power and performance validation, silicon characterization or system performance engineering

  • Experience leading or managing engineering teams within a technical environment

  • Deep understanding of modern SoC architecture, including CPU, memory, interconnect and high-speed I/O technologies

  • Strong Linux systems knowledge and low-level performance analysis experience

  • Strong Python programming skills for automation, orchestration and data analysis

  • Experience with benchmarking and profiling tools such as stress-ng, fio, perf, iperf or equivalent technologies

  • Experience debugging complex hardware and software interactions

  • Ability to define structured validation methodologies, workload models and test strategies

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify system bottlenecks

  • Strong communication, stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills

  • Ability to lead complex technical initiatives across geographically distributed teams


Desirable



  • Experience with AI accelerator, GPU or high-performance compute architectures

  • Experience with pre-silicon modelling or simulation environments

  • Knowledge of power management technologies and silicon characterization methodologies

  • Programming experience in C/C++ for low-level system or benchmark development

  • Familiarity with hardware instrumentation and telemetry systems

  • Experience working with high core-count or large-scale compute systems

  • Experience scaling or building technical engineering teams

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Principal Senior IT Auditor

Are you a critical thinker who thrives on unraveling complex technology risksDo you get excited by the idea of working with a diverse, forward-thinking team that uses cutting-edge tools and innovative techniquesIf so, we want to hear from you! Join Group Internal Audit at Swiss Re and play a pivotal role in advancing organizational resilience in an ever-evolving risk landscape.

About the Role

As a Principle Senior IT Auditor within Group Internal Audit (GIA), you'll bring your expertise in Information Technology and Cyber Security to life across a wide range of impactful audit activities. This is your chance to explore Swiss Re's diverse IT domains, deepen your understanding of processes and controls, and engage with topics that shape the organization's risk culture. Whether you're scoping an audit, uncovering insights, or presenting findings to senior stakeholders - your work will genuinely matter.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and participate in a variety of audits end-to-end - from scoping, planning and developing the testing plan, to executing the testing plan and documenting the results, to presenting the findings to the relevant stakeholders and finally writing and issuing the audit report.
  • Collaboration in the audit team - plan and deliver your assigned task and work in close collaboration with the audit team, challenge and coach the audit team to excel by acting as a role model, positively influence the overall audit outcome.
  • Drive technical excellence - apply and leverage your technology expertise to deliver advanced assurance over complex technology topics, support the development of innovative audit techniques by applying automation, AI and data analytics.
  • Workpaper review - review the work of peers and more junior audit team members and provide feedback and coaching.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with IT stakeholders - interact with IT management as part of audits and regular meetings and engage with various stakeholders across the business.
  • Contribute to the development of the audit plan - apply your expertise and use the information gained from stakeholders to provide inputs for future audit topics.

About You

You're intellectually curious, delivery-oriented, and a natural collaborator. You bring a critical mindset to everything you do and thrive in environments where no two days look the same. You communicate with confidence and clarity in English, and you're comfortable navigating ambiguity with composure. Above all, you're genuinely passionate about technology, innovation, and transformation - and you want your work to have real impact.

Essentials

  • At least 7 years of work experience in IT auditing and/or practical experience in the field of IT and Cyber security
  • Advanced understanding of IT risk and controls and the underlying technologies, concepts and processes
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt quickly to changing demands and rapidly develop in-depth knowledge of new audit areas
  • Proficiency in English, written and spoken

Nice to Haves

  • Qualified for professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP, CSX-P, CIA, or actively working towards one
  • Experience with cloud services and related security principles
  • Experience with auditing AI systems or familiarity with AI governance and risk frameworks

Experience Level

Senior Level

title: Senior Data Manager - Training
companyName: Abdul Latif Jameel Poverty Action Lab
tagsAndSkills: data analytics,data pipelines,ai,adult learning,case studies,analytical skills,data collection,analytics
jobDescription:
About J-PAL South Asia:
J-PAL is a global research centre working to reduce poverty and fight climate change by ensuring that policy is informed by scientific evidence. Anchored by a network of over 1,100 researchers at universities across the world, J-PAL works with governments, NGOs, and donors to generate evidence and scale effective solutions. J-PAL South Asia, based at the Institute for Financial Management and Research (IFMR) in Chennai, leads J-PAL s efforts to advance evidence-informed policymaking across the region. The office works with over 20 state governments and multiple central ministries in India, across sectors including health, education, labour markets, energy, environment, climate action, and gender.
J-PAL South Asia hosts CLEAR South Asia, the Regional Centre for Learning on Evaluation and Results, coordinated by the World Bank s Independent Evaluation Group (IEG). CLEAR South Asia is a key implementing partner of the Global Evaluation Initiative (GEI), a global network of institutions dedicated to strengthening evaluation capacities in developing countries.
About the Training Vertical:
The Training vertical at J-PAL South Asia works to strengthen monitoring, evaluation, data, and evidence-use capacities and systems. The team delivers open-enrolment and customised courses, technical advisory services, fellowships, knowledge products, and long-term institutional capacity-building engagements with governments and other development partners. J-PAL South Asia also hosts CLEAR South Asia, a key implementing partner of the Global Evaluation Initiative.
Role Summary:
J-PAL South Asia seeks a data-focused Training Manager / Senior Manager to lead the design and delivery of capacity-building programmes that help public institutions and social-sector organisations improve how they collect, manage, analyse, govern, and use data for decision-making and evaluation. The role sits at the intersection of applied data analytics, monitoring and evaluation, adult learning, and institutional strengthening.
The successful candidate will translate real-world administrative and programme data challenges into rigorous, practice-oriented curricula and advisory engagements. They will lead technical content development, facilitate training for diverse audiences, manage partnerships and programmes, mentor team members, and help build a portfolio of data-capacity initiatives that is closely connected to J-PAL s research and policy mission.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Data-focused training strategy and portfolio development
    • Support the development and execution of the Training vertical s strategy for data and evidence capacity building, translating priorities into annual plans, milestones, budgets, and measurable outcomes.
    • Contribute to thought leadership on the evolving role of data systems, AI, and digital tools in M&E practice, helping government partners navigate opportunities and risks as these technologies reshape how evidence is generated and used in public systems.
    • Identify opportunities for new courses, technical assistance, fellowships, and institutional partnerships focused on administrative data, data governance, analytics, and evidence use.
    • Build a coherent pathway from foundational data literacy to advanced applied analytics, tailored to the needs of government officials, M&E practitioners, researchers, and implementing organisations.
    • Contribute to fundraising, proposal development, donor engagement, and the stewardship of existing grants.
  • Curriculum and technical content development
    • Lead the design, adaptation, and quality assurance of curricula, teaching materials, exercises, datasets, manuals, toolkits, and knowledge products on data-focused topics.
    • Develop applied learning content using realistic government and social-sector datasets, while ensuring confidentiality, ethical use, and appropriate data protection.
    • Create training modules for partners on topics such as data quality assessment, data cleaning and validation, reproducible workflows, administrative data systems, data visualisation, dashboarding, data governance, responsible data use, and the use of data for monitoring and evaluation.
    • Translate technical concepts into accessible and engaging learning experiences for audiences with different levels of quantitative proficiency.
    • Keep content current by drawing on J-PAL research, field experience, partner needs, and emerging good practices in public-interest data systems.
  • Training delivery and facilitation
    • Lead and facilitate high-quality in-person, virtual, and blended training programmes for government and non-government stakeholders.
    • Teach technical sessions and oversee hands-on labs using relevant software such as Excel, Stata, R, Python, SQL, or data-visualisation tools.
    • Design assessments, assignments, capstone exercises, and feedback mechanisms that measure learning and application rather than participation alone.
    • Coach other trainers and subject-matter experts to ensure consistency, accuracy, strong pedagogy, and an inclusive learner experience.
  • Technical advisory and institutional data-capacity strengthening
    • Work with state and central government partners, civil society organisations, and other institutions to diagnose data-system and analytical-capacity gaps.
    • Translate partner needs into feasible technical assistance plans, including data-quality protocols, documentation standards, reporting frameworks, analytical workflows, and capacity-building roadmaps.
    • Advise partners on strengthening data collection, metadata, data dictionaries, codebooks, validation rules, reproducible analysis, and responsible data-sharing practices.
    • Support partners to move from one-off analysis towards institutionalised routines for monitoring, learning, and evidence-informed decision-making.
    • Coordinate with J-PAL s research and policy teams to identify data assets and problem statements that may support future research or evaluation opportunities.
  • Programme and partnership management
    • Manage multiple training and advisory engagements end to end, including scoping, work planning, staffing, contracting, delivery, risk management, reporting, and close-out.
    • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior government officials, donors, universities, technical partners, and civil society organisations.
    • Ensure programmes are responsive to partner needs while maintaining J-PAL s standards for technical quality and ethical data use.
    • Represent the Training vertical in external meetings, workshops, and ecosystem convenings.
  • Learning, knowledge management, and evidence of programme effectiveness
    • Develop monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks for data-capacity programmes, tracking learning gains, application of skills, institutional adoption, and improvements in data practices.
    • Create and maintain reusable repositories of curricula, code examples, teaching datasets, templates, case studies, and delivery guidance.
    • Lead the production of practical briefs, case notes, playbooks, and donor-facing learning products that document what works in strengthening institutional data capacity.
    • Use learner and partner feedback to continuously improve programme design and delivery.
  • Team leadership and organisational contribution
    • Supervise, mentor, and support Training Associates, Senior Training Associates, consultants as the need may be.
    • Set clear goals and quality standards, review technical outputs, and support the professional development of team members.
    • Contribute to financial and operational management, grant reporting, recruitment, and cross-vertical organisational initiatives.
    • Promote a collaborative culture that combines technical rigour, practical problem-solving, and strong partner orientation.
Minimum Qualifications:
  • Master s degree in economics, statistics, data science, computer science and AI, engineering or a related quantitative or social science field.
  • For Manager: at least 5 years of relevant professional experience. For Senior Manager: typically 7 or more years of relevant experience, including substantial programme or team leadership.
  • Demonstrated experience using data for public policy, monitoring and evaluation, social-impact programmes, government advisory, or applied research.
  • Strong applied data-analysis skills and proficiency in at least one statistical programming language such as R, or Python; working knowledge of SQL is strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with large, messy, or administrative datasets, including data cleaning, validation, documentation, analysis, and visualisation.
  • Strong understanding of monitoring and evaluation concepts, research workflows, and the role of administrative data in evidence-informed decision-making.
  • Experience designing and delivering technical training, workshops, curricula, or advisory services for adult learners.
  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, budgets, and external relationships.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Willingness to travel within India.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience working directly with state or central government departments, public data systems, multilaterals, or large-scale social programmes.
  • Experience developing data pipelines, reusable code libraries, dashboards, automated reporting workflows, or data-quality systems.
  • Familiarity with data governance, privacy, ethical data use, data-sharing agreements, and responsible use of sensitive administrative data.
  • Knowledge of causal inference, impact evaluation, survey design, sampling, or identification strategies.
  • Experience using geospatial data, machine learning, cloud-based analytical environments, or business-intelligence tools in applied development settings.
  • Experience developing open-source curricula, technical manuals, operational toolkits, or knowledge products.
  • Prior experience with fundraising, grant management, donor reporting, or partnership development.
  • Fluency in Hindi.
Core Competencies:
  • Technical depth with practical judgement: Strong understanding and expertise in data governance in governments and other partners; Applies strong analytical skills to real institutional problems and selects tools appropriate to the context.
  • Pedagogical leadership: Designs rigorous, accessible, and practice-oriented learning experiences for diverse adult learners.
  • Institutional capacity building: Looks beyond one-off training to strengthen systems, routines, documentation, and organisational ownership on data governance.
  • Partner orientation: Builds trust, listens carefully, and co-creates solutions that are technically sound and operationally feasible.
  • Operational excellence: Plans and delivers complex programmes with attention to quality, timelines, budgets, and risk.
  • Communication: Explains technical ideas clearly and produces high-quality written, visual, and oral outputs.
  • People leadership: Sets clear expectations, gives constructive feedback, and supports the growth of a diverse team.
  • Mission alignment: Demonstrates a strong commitment to evidence-informed policy and the responsible use of data for social good
Work Authorisation:
  • Candidates must be authorized to work in India.
Application:
  • Interested candidates should submit a CV and cover letter describing their relevant experience in applied data work, capacity building, and stakeholder management. Candidates may be asked to complete a technical and/or teaching exercise as part of the selection process.

jobDescription:
We are looking for a Principal Cosmos DB Architect with 1015 years of experience to spearhead the data architecture for our mission-critical OCR and AI platforms. This senior leadership role requires a deep mastery of Java development and NoSQL modeling to build high-performance systems. You will act as the strategic link between data design and application logic, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver global scalability, minimal latency, and optimized cost-efficiency.
Essential functions
Key Responsibilities
  • Data Architecture & Design: Lead the design and implementation of complex data models using Azure Cosmos DB (SQL/Core API), ensuring optimal partitioning and indexing strategies.

  • Java Integration: Develop and maintain robust data access layers using Java and Spring Boot, ensuring seamless integration between our services and the database.

  • Cloud Infrastructure: Strong architectural knowledge of Azure Cloud services and how they integrate with distributed database systems.

jobDescription:
Job purpose
Seeking a hands-on Data Engineer to design, build, and automate data pipelines that bring new datasets onto the platform quickly and reliably as they are identified by the investment team
Key priority is core data engineering: ingesting, transforming, and organising data so it lands in the right place, in the right shape. Over time, the role will extend into the firm's AI roadmap preparing large document sets for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), managing vector databases, and enabling effective querying across integrated datasets to generate insight and reporting.
This is not a fixed-scope project role. The engineer will operate as a responsive, standing capability picking up new pipeline builds as analysts surface new data requirements, while maintaining and improving what is already in place.

Pipeline development Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines to ingest new datasets onto the firm's data platform as demand arises from the investment and analyst teams.
Automation Automate ingestion, transformation, and data-quality workflows to reduce manual effort and speed up onboarding of new sources.
Data platform Structure and organise datasets so they can be integrated, joined, and queried effectively across the platform.
AI enablement (roadmap) Process large volumes of documents into formats suitable for AI consumption; store and index content in vector databases; support retrieval workflows (RAG) that surface the right information reliably.
Insight & reporting (roadmap) Enable effective querying across multiple integrated datasets to combine information and support sensible, decision-ready reporting.
Stakeholder collaboration Work directly with the hiring manager and analysts to scope new requirements, prioritize the pipeline backlog, and respond quickly as new needs emerge.
Key competencies
Required Skills
45+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, ideally within financial services or data intensive environments.
Strong experience building and orchestrating data pipelines with Apache Airflow.
Solid working knowledge of Apache Spark for large-scale data processing.
Strong Python and SQL skills, with a focus on clean, maintainable, production-quality code.
Experience designing data models and organizing datasets for downstream integration and querying.
Track record of automating data workflows and building for reliability, monitoring, and data quality.
Comfortable operating with loosely defined, evolving scope able to self-organize, scope work with stakeholders, and deliver iteratively.
Nice to Have
Exposure to AI/LLM engineering: document processing at scale, embeddings, and vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or similar).
Experience building or supporting retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workflows.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms and modern data stack tooling.
Prior experience supporting investment management, hedge fund, or capital markets data environments.
Experience working as a dedicated remote resource embedded with a client team.

jobDescription:
Group Company: PhysicsWallah Limited

Designation: Associate Manager

Key Responsibilities

  • Requirement Gathering Documentation
    • Partner with HR leadership and business stakeholders to understand reporting and analytics requirements
    • Translate business needs into clear Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and functional specifications
    • Prioritize and scope requests based on business impact, urgency, and feasibility
  • Data Structuring Cleaning
    • Consolidate HR data from multiple sources, including HRMS, payroll, attendance, recruitment, and exit data
    • Clean, validate, and structure raw datasets into reliable, analysis-ready formats
    • Build and maintain standardized templates and master datasets to ensure consistency and minimize reporting errors
  • Dashboard Visualization Development
    • Design and build interactive, intuitive dashboards (Power BI, Tableau, or advanced Excel/Google Sheets) covering key HR metrics such as attrition, headcount, hiring funnel, engagement, and performance
    • Ensure dashboards are accurate, regularly refreshed, and easy to interpret for non-technical audiences
    • Continuously refine visualizations based on stakeholder feedback and evolving business priorities
  • Advanced Excel Spreadsheet Management
    • Build and maintain complex formulas, pivot tables, and data models in Excel/Google Sheets
    • Maintain organized, error-free trackers for headcount, compensation, attendance, and other core HR datasets
  • AI Emerging Tools Capability
    • Leverage AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to accelerate analysis, summarize large datasets, and generate quick insights
    • Stay current on AI-assisted analytics tools and recommend adoption where it improves efficiency
    • Explore opportunities to apply predictive analytics to HR use cases such as attrition risk and hiring forecasts
  • Insights Reporting
    • Convert data into clear, actionable insights that support leadership decision-making
    • Prepare periodic (weekly, monthly, quarterly) HR MIS reports with a high standard of accuracy
    • Proactively identify trends, anomalies, and improvement opportunities within HR data, rather than relying solely on ad-hoc requests

Required Skills

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, array formulas)
  • Strong working knowledge of at least one visualization tool: Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio
  • Basic to intermediate SQL knowledge is an advantage
  • Comfortable adopting AI tools to enhance analytical productivity

Functional Skills

  • Solid understanding of core HR processes and metrics (attrition, recruitment funnel, headcount planning, performance, engagement)
  • Demonstrated experience writing BRDs and converting business requirements into technical deliverables
  • Strong data cleaning and structuring skills across multiple, often unstructured, data sources

Soft Skills

  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to extract clear requirements from non-technical HR and business users
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy
  • Ability to simplify complex datasets into clear, compelling visual narratives
  • Self-driven and proactive in identifying reporting gaps and improvement opportunities

Education

  • Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline; background in Statistics, Commerce, HR, or Data Analytics preferred
  • Certifications in Power BI, Tableau, or Data Analytics are an added advantage

Experience Requirement

3-5 years of relevant experience in HR analytics, MIS, or data analytics roles. Strong preference for HR domain exposure; candidates with a robust analytics background and willingness to learn HR processes will also be considered.

Why This Role Matters

This is a high-impact, hybrid role for someone who can own the complete cycle - understanding the business problem, structuring the underlying data, building the visualization, and delivering the final insight. This person will serve as the analytical backbone of the HR function, directly enabling faster and more informed people decisions.

We are seeking an experienced AI/ML Engineer with expertise in designing, training, deploying, and maintaining AI/ML solutions on Azure AI/ML ecosystem. AI/ML Solution Development

  • Risk Analytics: Predictive modelling for deviations, CAPA effectiveness, and process bottlenecks using Azure Machine Learning.

Azure AI/ML Ecosystem Integration:




  • Deploy and monitor models on Azure Machine Learning (pipelines, endpoints, versioning).

  • Leverage Azure Cognitive Services (AI Services) for text analytics, translation, and anomaly detection.

  • Implement vector embeddings & semantic search using Azure AI Search with compliance datasets.

  • Integrate Azure OpenAI for natural language Q&A, audit assistant, and regulatory chatbot.



Collaboration & Leadership




  • Work closely with QMS/LMS product teams to identify AI-driven automation opportunities.

  • Collaborate with compliance, QA, and regulatory experts to ensure adherence.

  • Provide technical mentorship for junior AI engineers and data scientists.











Required Skills & Experience




  • 5+ years of hands-on AI/ML development & deployment.

  • Strong experience with Azure AI stack:

    • Azure Machine Learning (pipelines, ML-Ops, model registry, monitoring).

    • Azure AI Search (vector DB, embeddings, semantic ranking).

    • Azure OpenAI (prompt engineering, fine-tuning).

    • Azure AI Services (translation, text analytics, anomaly detection).

    • Azure Document Intelligence (OCR, form recognition, entity extraction).



  • Strong programming experience in Python (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).

  • Experience with ML-Ops best practices (CI/CD for ML, model lifecycle, drift detection).

  • Hands-on with data engineering pipelines (Azure Data Factory, Event Grid, Databricks).

  • Prior experience in model training, fine-tuning, and deployment at scale.

  • Good understanding of regulatory compliance (21 CFR Part 11, GDPR) for AI systems.

descriptionFromApi:
As Senior Data Scientist for Model Validation, you will work closely with datascientists, model developers, risk leaders, and compliance teams to ensure models meetregulatory expectations, statistical soundness standards, and business objectives. This role will provide you a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI/ML-driven creditdecisioning solutions while gaining deep exposure to the U.S. consumer lending ecosystem and regulatory environment.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct independent validation of credit risk models used across the customer lifecycle including behavioural risk models and AI/ML-based credit decisioning models

  • Assess conceptual soundness, model methodology, assumptions, variable selection, feature engineering techniques, and model design.

  • Help establish and maintain a model inventory covering all models in production, development, and retirement stages, including risk tier and metadata management.

  • Define and implement model materiality classification criteria (High / Medium /Low) to prioritize validation activities and resource allocation.

  • Support development of MRM policies, procedures, and standards aligned with SR 26-2 (the current interagency guidance issued April 2026, superseding SR 11-7) from inception, applying its principles-based, risk-proportionate approach.

  • Execute validation using champion-challenger framework, benchmarking, stress testing, and sensitivity analysis.

  • Validate model implementation by verifying that production code and system outputs match approved model specifications.

  • Assess data quality, data lineage, and feature appropriateness, including reviewof credit bureau data usage.

  • Define ongoing monitoring standards including PSI, CSI, Gini/KS tracking thresholds, and escalation triggers for model performance degradation. Review periodic model performance monitoring reports

  • Evaluate fairness, bias, and model transparency considerations particularly for AI/ML models used in credit decisioning under ECOA/Reg B.

  • Author end-to-end validation reports covering scope, data assessment, methodology review, findings, risk ratings, compensating controls, and formal recommendations (Approve / Conditionally Approve / Reject).

  • Assign and justify model risk ratings based on model materiality, complexity, intended use, and potential business impact.

  • Review model development documentation, implementation documents, monitoring reports, and change management records.

  • Ensure all MRM activities comply with SR 26-2, OCC Bulletin 2026-13,

  • ECOA/Reg B, and FCRA regulatory requirements. Apply SR 26-2 &risk-based,proportionate approach to validation prioritization and governance design.

  • Partner with model development, risk, compliance, and technology teams to discuss findings and agree on remediation plans and model change management processes.

  • Present validation results to senior management, model governance committees,and client stakeholders.

  • Support external audits, regulatory examinations, and client due diligence activities.

Skills & Competencies

  • 5-7 years of experience in Model Validation and Quantitative Risk Management

  • Bachelor degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science,Engineering, or a related quantitative field required. Master s degree or PhD preferred.

  • Prior experience working within a formal MRM function is required.

  • Prior experience supporting U.S. banks, credit unions, fintechs, or consumer lenders.

  • Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, SHAP and LIME for model explainability, familiarity with champion-challenger frameworks and model monitoring tooling.

    • Exception handling

    • Unit/integration testing
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, containerization, and production deployment.

Big Data & Data Engineering :

  • Strong understanding of Big Data architectures and distributed data processing.
  • Experience working with very large datasets and high-volume data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with technologies such as:
    • Apache Spark / PySpark
    • Kafka
    • Amazon S3
    • Amazon Athena
    • Parquet, CSV, JSON and other data formats
    • Data lakes and analytical databases
  • Understanding of distributed computing, partitioning, parallel processing, data serialization, and query optimization.

AWS & Cloud :

Strong hands-on experience with AWS services, particularly:

  • AWS Lambda serverless applications and data-processing workflows.
  • Amazon S3 data lake and object storage.
  • Amazon Athena querying large-scale datasets.
  • AWS KMS encryption and key management.
  • AWS Secrets Manager secure management of credentials and secrets.

Location: India / Remote

Open to Travel: Yes, as required


About the Role

Wisewit Solutions is looking for a Fisheries Research Analyst AI & Computer Vision to bridge the gap between fisheries domain expertise and AI technology.

The role will involve researching fisheries and aquaculture processes, understanding real-world field challenges, collecting and validating domain data, and working closely with AI/ML and Computer Vision teams to develop practical technology solutions.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of fish/aquaculture species, farming, seafood processing plants, production lines, exports, and fisheries terminology, along with an interest in AI, data and emerging technologies.


Key Responsibilities

Fisheries Domain Research

  • Research Indian marine, inland fisheries and aquaculture practices.
  • Study fish and shrimp species, production processes, farming practices and harvesting operations.
  • Understand fish health, disease indicators, feed, water quality and environmental parameters.
  • Research fisheries value chains, landing centres, farms, processing units and field operations.
  • Identify operational challenges that can potentially be addressed using AI and automation.

AI & Computer Vision Research

  • You will work with AI/ML and Computer Vision teams to translate fisheries requirements into technical inputs.
  • Identify suitable use cases for image-based identification, classification, detection and monitoring.
  • Help define fish/species categories, attributes, visual characteristics and domain-specific classifications.
  • Assist in developing guidelines for image and video data collection.
  • Review and validate AI-generated outputs from a fisheries-domain perspective.
  • Identify false positives, false negatives and domain-specific errors in AI models.
  • Support creation and validation of datasets for Computer Vision and Machine Learning projects.

Data & Dataset Development

  • Collect fisheries-related data from research papers, government sources, field studies and industry sources.
  • Organise and clean structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Support image/video dataset creation and annotation activities.
  • Develop domain-specific taxonomies, labels, metadata and reference datasets.
  • Verify the accuracy and consistency of annotated data.
  • Maintain documentation and version-controlled research references.

Field Research & Validation

  • Conduct field visits to farms, hatcheries, fishing locations, landing centres and processing facilities.
  • Interact with fishermen, farmers, aquaculture professionals and other domain experts.
  • Document actual field processes and operational challenges.
  • Collect images, videos, observations and other relevant field data.
  • Validate whether AI solutions work effectively under real-world conditions.

Research & Documentation

  • Conduct literature reviews and analyse scientific publications.
  • Track developments in fisheries technology, AI applications and aquaculture.
  • Prepare research reports, use-case documents and domain briefs.
  • Create clear documentation for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Present research findings to AI, engineering and business teams.

AI Use Cases You May Work On

Depending on the project, the role may contribute to areas such as:

  • Fish and shrimp species identification
  • Fish size/length estimation
  • Fish counting and biomass estimation
  • Fish quality assessment
  • Disease or abnormality detection
  • Aquaculture pond monitoring
  • Fish grading and sorting
  • Fish catch classification
  • Image/video-based fisheries monitoring
  • Farm productivity analysis
  • Fisheries supply-chain intelligence
  • Computer Vision-based inspection systems

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Fisheries Science, Aquaculture, Marine Biology, Zoology, Aquatic Sciences or a related field.
  • 15 years of experience in fisheries, aquaculture, fisheries research, field research or a related domain.
  • Strong understanding of Indian fisheries/aquaculture practices.
  • Good research, analytical and documentation skills.
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
  • Ability to interpret scientific papers, research reports and technical information.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work with multidisciplinary teams.

Good to Have

  • Exposure to AI/ML, Computer Vision or Data Science.
  • Experience with image/video data collection or annotation.
  • Knowledge of Python, SQL, Power BI or similar analytical tools.
  • Familiarity with GIS/geospatial data.
  • Experience working with fisheries datasets.
  • Knowledge of fish/shrimp species identification.
  • Experience conducting field surveys or stakeholder interviews.
  • Understanding of AI model evaluation or dataset validation.

Who Would Be a Good Fit?

We are looking for someone who can say:

I understand fisheries, I understand the problem in the field, and I can explain that problem clearly enough for an AI/engineering team to build a solution.”

You don’t need to be an AI engineer. However, you should be curious about AI and comfortable working closely with technical teams.


Key Skills

Fisheries Domain | Aquaculture | Research | Data Analysis | Field Research | Dataset Validation | Computer Vision | AI Use Cases | Documentation | Stakeholder Interaction


Travel

This role may require travel to aquaculture farms, fishing locations, landing centres, processing facilities, research institutions and client locations across India.

Candidates should be comfortable with travel as required by project requirements.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Were looking for an engineer to ensure the reliable operation of production environments for our Data Infrastructure and products, running at scale on large-volume distributed cloud systems. Youll focus on maximizing system reliability, automating routine tasks, and improving production efficiency.

This role offers hands-on exposure to modern cloud technologies - Docker, Kubernetes, networking, and platforms like AWS and GCP - while you contribute directly to system uptime and user experience for a large-scale distributed application.

Youll lead production monitoring and incident response, drive automation to reduce manual work, and collaborate with Engineering on root cause analysis, CI/CD support, and capacity planning.

Whats in it for you:

In this role, you will be responsible for seamless operation of production environments for our Data Infrastructure and products within large-scale, high-volume distributed cloud systems. You will concentrate on maximizing system reliability, automating routine tasks, and maintaining the efficiency of our production systems.

This role provides practical cloud exposure to help you deepen your expertise in modern technology stacks, such as Docker, Kubernetes, Networking, and major public cloud providers like AWS and GCP. You will have the chance to contribute to enhancing user experience and system uptime for a large-scale distributed application.

What you will be doing:

  • Monitoring: Use observability dashboards to monitor system performance, error rates, and resource utilization. Define new dashboards and alerts as and when required and write technical runbooks for Incident response.
  • Incident Response: Act as the initial point of contact for production alerts, mitigate/solve the ongoing issues, escalate highly complex problems to the Engineering team, and conduct thorough root cause analysis for incidents.
  • Automation: Identify repetitive manual tasks and streamline them through automation.
  • Support CI/CD: Help create, test, and maintain automated application deployment pipelines.
  • Capacity Management: Assist in tracking system resource usage (CPU, memory, storage) and traffic volume to help forecast and scale infrastructure needs

Required skills and experience:

  • 5+ years of overall industry experience in a relevant technical role
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language, preferably Python
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, and related cluster concepts
  • Strong understanding of public cloud infrastructure, with a preference for AWS (GCP experience also considered)
  • Working knowledge of Linux/Unix command-line environments and core web protocols including HTTP, gRPC, DNS, and TCP/IP
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana and Prometheus is a plus
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, along with workflow automation via GitHub Actions, is a plus
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation and respond to production incidents with flexibility to support critical systems

Education

  • BSCS or equivalent required, MSCS or equivalent strongly preferred

Job Summary

To champion a culture of compliance and risk awareness across Sleek, ensuring adherence to regulatory standards globally while driving continuous improvement in our technology and processes.

Key outcomes in the first 6-12 months

Outcome 1: Know Your Customer (KYC)

  • Review individual KYC exceptions and complete identification/verification within agreed SLAs.
  • Complete corporate shareholder KYC reviews accurately and within agreed SLAs.
  • Ensure all KYC decisions and supporting documentation are complete and appropriately recorded.

Outcome 2: Client Risk Assessment

  • Independently approve low- and medium-risk client cases within SLA.
  • Assess higher-risk cases and provide clear recommendations to the Head of Compliance within SLA.
  • Apply sound judgement and a consistent, risk-based approach when assessing client risk.

Outcome 3: Screening Monitoring Alerts

  • Review name screening alerts within SLA and accurately determine whether they are false positives or potential true hits requiring escalation.
  • Review transaction monitoring alerts within SLA and determine whether they can be closed or require further investigation.
  • Ensure decisions are appropriately documented and escalated where required.

Outcome 4: Process Technology Improvement

  • Review existing Compliance policies, tools and processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Work with the Head of Compliance to improve the efficiency, consistency and effectiveness of compliance operations.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage technology and AI to improve compliance workflows and decision-making.

Must-have experience

  • Bachelors degree.
  • Experience in a role involving analysis, judgement and/or risk assessment; previous Compliance experience is not strictly required.
  • Experience using AI tools in the workplace, ideally including experimentation with or practical exposure to agentic AI.

  • Ability to work with data and technology and learn new systems quickly.

Must-have attributes

  • Structured thinking sound judgement - able to assess complex information, identify risks and make well-reasoned decisions.
  • Excellent communication - strong written and spoken English, with the ability to clearly explain decisions and recommendations.
  • Curiosity humility - naturally curious, open to learning and comfortable challenging their own assumptions.
  • Data-driven tech savvy - comfortable working with data and adopting new technologies, including AI tools.
  • Ability to persuade and be persuaded - confident in presenting a point of view while remaining open to alternative perspectives.
  • Self-awareness self-management - understands their strengths and development areas and can manage their work independently in a fast-moving environment.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility

Humility: There is so much we don t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Attention to detail

Attention to detail: You ll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.

Excellent listener and clear communicator

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn t their first language. For you to excel, you ll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

One-way Video Interview

A one-way video interview will be used to understand your skills, experience and interest in Compliance early in the process.

Technical Round

A 90-minute interview with a member of the Hiring Team. This will include a live assessment of your analytical thinking, judgement and ability to work through Compliance-related scenarios.

Behavioural / Soft Skills Round

A 60-minute interview focusing on your recent work situations and how you demonstrate ownership, humility, structured thinking, attention to detail, communication and judgement.

Reference Verification

Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. This step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

Role: Senior Product Designer / Founding Product Team Member

About Kefilo

Kefilo is building a human transformation ecosystem focused on functional nutrition, preventive wellness, gut health and lifestyle redesign.

We are building beyond a traditional food-delivery model, with a focus on personalized nutrition, 90-day transformation programs, measurable outcomes, customer engagement and technology-enabled wellness.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer who can take ownership of the product design function at Kefilo and help design a simple, intuitive and scalable digital experience for our customers and internal teams.

The role will involve understanding customer problems, designing user journeys, building the app experience, creating design systems and working closely with the founder, developers, nutritionists and operations team to turn business and customer requirements into a strong product.

This is an equity-based founding team opportunity for someone who wants to take ownership of product design and help shape Kefilos digital ecosystem from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end product design process from user research and problem definition to wireframes, prototypes and final UI.

  • Design intuitive mobile and web experiences for customers, nutritionists, operations and internal teams.

  • Design user journeys for meal subscriptions, personalized nutrition, transformation programs, assessments, progress tracking and customer engagement.

  • Convert complex nutrition and wellness information into simple and easy-to-understand user experiences.

  • Conduct user research, competitor analysis and usability testing to identify customer needs and product improvements.

  • Create wireframes, user flows, high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes using Figma or similar tools.

  • Develop and maintain a consistent design system, component library and product design guidelines.

  • Work closely with developers to ensure designs are implemented accurately and efficiently.

  • Collaborate with nutritionists, food scientists, marketing and operations teams to understand requirements and translate them into product experiences.

  • Design dashboards and internal tools for customer management, subscriptions, nutrition, kitchen operations and business analytics.

  • Design data visualizations and progress-tracking interfaces that help customers understand their transformation journey.

  • Continuously analyse user feedback, product behaviour and usability issues and improve the product accordingly.

  • Explore how AI and personalization can be incorporated into the customer experience.

  • Help establish the overall visual language, interaction principles and digital brand experience for Kefilo.

Ideal Candidate

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in product design, UX/UI design or digital product development.

  • Strong proficiency in Figma and modern product design tools.

  • Strong understanding of UX research, information architecture, user flows, interaction design and visual design.

  • Experience designing mobile-first products and responsive web applications.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating real-world digital products and end-to-end design processes.

  • Ability to simplify complex information and create intuitive user experiences.

  • Experience with consumer apps, D2C, health-tech, wellness, food-tech or subscription products is an advantage.

  • Understanding of design systems and developer handoff.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership in an early-stage startup.

  • Interest in nutrition, wellness, technology, AI and consumer products is an advantage.

What You Get

  • Founding Senior Product Designer position at Kefilo.

  • Equity participation.

  • Direct collaboration with the founder and multidisciplinary founding team.

  • Opportunity to shape Kefilos digital product and customer experience from the ground up.

  • Ownership of the product design system and overall digital experience.

  • Opportunity to work at the intersection of food, nutrition, wellness, technology and transformation.

  • Potential to grow into a core product/design leadership role as Kefilo scales.

Important

This is an equity-only opportunity with no fixed salary at the current stage.

The expected contribution is 20-25 hours per week on a remote, part-time basis. We are looking for someone genuinely interested in building long-term value and taking ownership of a core product function.

The founder onboarding process includes 3-4 strategic discussions followed by a 1-month NDA-based collaboration phase to evaluate expertise, execution, ownership and long-term alignment.

Equity will be structured based on contribution, responsibility and commitment, with a 5-year vesting structure for core founding members.

Fixed compensation will be introduced after fundraising and revenue stabilization.

If you are primarily looking for a fixed-salary position, this opportunity may not be suitable at the current stage.

Job Title: Sr. People Operations Specialist

Location: India (Remote)

Shift: 9:30AM - 6:30PM IST

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Sr. People Operations Specialist to join our growing People Operations team. This role is responsible for owning key People Operations processes and ensuring accurate, timely, and consistent delivery across the employee lifecycle.

The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on People Operations experience, is comfortable independently managing complex operational matters, and can identify opportunities to improve processes and employee experience. You are organized, comfortable working with systems and data, and able to collaborate effectively across teams while navigating a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.

You will also contribute to improving operational efficiency, adopting automation and AI-enabled solutions, and driving consistent People Operations practices across the team.

Responsibilities

People Operations

  • Own key employee lifecycle processes including offboarding, role transitions, promotions, transfers, and other internal movements.
  • Manage employee requests and People Operations tickets, independently resolving complex queries and acting as an escalation point for operational issues within assigned areas.
  • Own recurring People Operations activities including leave and attendance management, localized benefits administration, payroll inputs and validations, employee documentation, and employment verification.
  • Support People Operations across India, the US, and EOR populations based on business requirements.
  • Maintain process documentation, SOPs, trackers, and controls to ensure consistent and reliable execution.
  • Own or contribute to People Operations projects and initiatives based on business priorities.

Process Improvement, Automation and Collaboration

  • Review operational data, SLA trends, recurring issues, and process gaps to identify and drive opportunities for improvement.
  • Improve People Operations processes and workflows to reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency and employee experience.
  • Partner with People Technology on HR system enhancements, integrations, testing, workflow changes, and automation initiatives.
  • Leverage AI and other technology solutions to streamline routine activities and improve operational efficiency while ensuring appropriate handling of employee and confidential data.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including Payroll, Finance, IT, Talent Acquisition, Legal, and People Technology to resolve operational dependencies and improve processes.
  • Support the implementation and adoption of new or updated People systems, policies, and processes.

Data Management, Compliance and Reporting

  • Maintain the accuracy and integrity of employee data and lifecycle transactions across the HRIS and related People systems.
  • Conduct regular audits and reconciliations, identify data discrepancies or operational risks, and drive timely resolution.

jobDescription:
Senior Kernel / Systems Software Engineer


Role: Senior Kernel / Systems Software Engineer


Location: Pune

Experience: 5 to 10 years

About the Role

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Kernel / Systems Software Engineer with 5-10 years of hands-on experience in low-level systems programming. In this role, you will design, architect, and optimize core operating system components, kernel-mode drivers, and system-level

software. You will tackle complex challenges related to OS internals, hardware abstraction, and high-performance concurrency.

Whether working on Windows or Linux environments, you will be responsible for ensuring ultra-low latency, maximum stability, and tight resource utilization across multi-threaded and multi-processor systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design & Architecture: Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of high-performance kernel modules, system services, and device drivers.
  • OS Internals & Performance: Optimize core system components for latency, memory footprint, CPU utilization, and overall system throughput.
  • Low-Level Debugging: Troubleshoot complex low-level issues, including kernel panics/bug checks, memory corruption, deadlocks, race conditions, and hardware-software interaction faults.
  • System Security & Stability: Enforce secure coding practices in ring 0 / privilege mode environments to prevent vulnerability exploits and system crashes.
  • Technical Leadership: Participate in architectural reviews, establish coding standards, mentor junior engineers, and drive technical decision-making across teams.
  • AI-Assisted Workflows: Leverage AI coding assistants and LLM tools to accelerate code generation, prototyping, and test scenario creation while maintaining rigorous manual verification.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with QA, Hardware, and DevOps teams to streamline driver/module deployment, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Education: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics, or a related technical field.
  • Core Systems Experience: 510 years of deep systems programming experience in C and C++ within low-level software environments.
  • OS Internals Expertise: Advanced, practical understanding of operating system concepts, including privilege levels (User Mode vs. Kernel Mode), Virtual Memory Management, Interrupt Handling, DMA, Synchronization Primitives, and Multithreading/Concurrency models.
  • OS Agnostic / Cross-Platform Exposure: Deep familiarity with OS API layers and kernel paradigms on Linux (POSIX, Syscalls) or Windows (Win32, Native API, WDF/KMDF), with the adaptability to work across both platforms.
  • Advanced Debugging: Proven experience using kernel-level debuggers and profiling tools (e.g., WinDbg, GDB, Valgrind, Trace32, Perf, or OS-native crash dump analysis tools).
  • Hardware Interfacing: Experience interfacing software directly with underlying hardware architecture (x86/x64, ARM, PCIe, Bus interfaces).
  • Build & Version Control: Proficiency with Git, complex build systems (CMake, Makefiles, MSBuild), and CI/CD integration.
  • AI Tool Integration:

Hands-on experience using AI assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to optimize workflows.

Strong capability to craft precise technical prompts and validate/fact-check AI-generated code for edge cases, security risks, and AI hallucinations.

  • Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving skills, strong architectural thinking, and the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Skills (Good to Have)

  • Direct experience writing and certifying kernel-mode device drivers (e.g., Windows Driver Frameworks [KMDF/UMDF] or Linux Kernel Modules [LKM]).
  • Experience with hypervisors, virtualization technologies (KVM, Hyper-V, Xen), or container runtimes.
  • Knowledge of high-speed networking stack internals (TCP/IP, DPDK, RDMA) or storage stacks (NVMe, SCSI).
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, Bash) for test automation and build tooling.
  • Experience with static code analysis, thread sanitizers, and zero-trust memory safety standards.

Forward Deployed AI Engineer – LLM & AI Automation
Telesat is looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) to help bring AI from prototypes into real-world engineering environments.
In this role, you’ll work closely with system test engineers, automation teams, QA, and software development teams to identify opportunities for AI, build practical solutions, and make them reliable enough for production use.
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working closely with users, and turning AI capabilities into measurable improvements in engineering productivity.

AI Deployment & Automation
  • Take LLM and Generative AI prototypes and turn them into production-ready, repeatable solutions.
  • Integrate AI solutions with existing engineering applications, automation frameworks, APIs, and workflows.
  • Build orchestration and integration logic across multiple systems using Python.
  • Deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve AI-powered solutions.

AI in System Test Automation

  • Understand real-world testing workflows, constraints, and failure modes.
  • Identify areas where AI can safely reduce manual effort and improve productivity.
  • Adapt AI workflows to work with existing automation frameworks, test data, schemas, and configurations.

  • Use real test results and failure analysis to continuously improve AI behavior.

  • Work closely with engineers and end users to understand their challenges and workflows.
  • Rapidly iterate on solutions based on real-world feedback.
  • Debug complex software and AI issues across multiple systems.

Overview:

We are seeking a Databricks Engineer to design, build, and operate a Data & AI platform

with a strong foundation in the Medallion Architecture (raw/bronze, curated/silver, and

mart/gold layers). This platform will orchestrate complex data workflows and scalable ELT

pipelines to integrate data from enterprise systems such as PeopleSoft, D2L, and

Salesforce, delivering high-quality, governed data for machine learning, AI/BI, and analytics

at scale.

You will play a critical role in engineering the infrastructure and workflows that enable

seamless data flow across the enterprise, ensure operational excellence, and provide the

backbone for strategic decision-making, predictive modeling, and innovation.

Responsibilities:

1. Data & AI Platform Engineering (Databricks-Centric):

• Design, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines on Databricks, following the

Medallion Architecture principles.

• Build robust and scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache Spark and Delta Lake to

transform raw (bronze) data into trusted curated (silver) and analytics-ready (gold) data

layers.

• Operationalize Databricks Workflows for orchestration, dependency management, and

pipeline automation.

• Apply schema evolution and data versioning to support agile data development.

2. Platform Integration & Data Ingestion:

• Connect and ingest data from enterprise systems such as PeopleSoft, D2L, and

Salesforce using APIs, JDBC, or other integration frameworks.

• Implement connectors and ingestion frameworks that accommodate structured, semi-

structured, and unstructured data.

• Design standardized data ingestion processes with automated error handling, retries,

and alerting.

3. Data Quality, Monitoring, and Governance:

• Develop data quality checks, validation rules, and anomaly detection mechanisms to

ensure data integrity across all layers.

• Integrate monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Databricks metrics, Grafana) to track

ETL performance, latency, and failures.

• Implement Unity Catalog or equivalent tools for centralized metadata management, data

lineage, and governance policy enforcement.

4. Security, Privacy, and Compliance:

• Enforce data security best practices including row-level security, encryption at rest/in

transit, and fine-grained access control via Unity Catalog.

• Design and implement data masking, tokenization, and anonymization for compliance

with privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, FERPA).

• Work with security teams to audit and certify compliance controls.


5. AI/ML-Ready Data Foundation:

• Enable data scientists by delivering high-quality, feature-rich data sets for model training

and inference.

• Support AIOps/MLOps lifecycle workflows using MLflow for experiment tracking, model

registry, and deployment within Databricks.

• Collaborate with AI/ML teams to create reusable feature stores and training pipelines.

6. Cloud Data Architecture and Storage:

• Architect and manage data lakes on Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS) or Amazon S3,

and design ingestion pipelines to feed the bronze layer.

• Build data marts and warehousing solutions using platforms like Databricks.

• Optimize data storage and access patterns for performance and cost-efficiency.

7. Documentation & Enablement:

• Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, data dictionaries, and

runbooks for all pipelines and components.

• Provide training and enablement sessions to internal stakeholders on the Databricks

platform, Medallion Architecture, and data governance practices.

• Conduct code reviews and promote reusable patterns and frameworks across teams.

8. Reporting and Accountability:

• Submit a weekly schedule of hours worked and progress reports outlining completed

tasks, upcoming plans, and blockers.

• Track deliverables against roadmap milestones and communicate risks or

dependencies.

Required Qualifications:

• Hands-on experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, and Apache Spark for large-scale

data engineering.

• Deep understanding of ELT pipeline development, orchestration, and monitoring in

cloud-native environments.

• Experience implementing Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and working with

data versioning and schema enforcement in enterprise grade environments.

• Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, or Scala for data transformations and workflow logic.

• Proven experience integrating enterprise platforms (e.g., PeopleSoft, Salesforce, D2L)

into centralized data platforms.

• Familiarity with data governance, lineage tracking, and metadata management tools.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog for metadata management and access control.

• Experience deploying ML models at scale using MLFlow or similar MLOps tools.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms like Azure or AWS, including storage, security, and

networking aspects.

• Knowledge of data warehouse design and star/snowflake schema modeling.
